remarks: Nestled on a private street in the sought-after Old Hill neighborhood, this contemporary/colonial style home provides the perfect blend of picturesque tranquility and convenience. The home is in pristine condition and is tastefully decorated featuring modern finishes, designer lighting and an overall inviting ambiance. Sunshine flows through the energy-efficient glass windows as you feel the spaciousness of this open-concept design with 16ft foyer & 10ft high ceilings. The main floor features a beautifully designed Dining Room with custom wine cellar, Great Room with fireplace, and stylish eat-in Kitchen with built-in wine-fridge and sleek shelving. A first floor bedroom with full bath and walk-in closet allows a flex space for guests, home office, playroom, gym, etc. A functional mudroom off the garage completes the floor. Upstairs showcases a stunning Primary Suite with cathedral ceiling, many closets, including 2 walk-ins and a full bath with soaking tub that creates a serene vibe. There are 2 more bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, full laundry room and an open area which could be used as a homework station, office, reading nook, or gaming/movie area. The 1.8 acres provides a perfect retreat with run-around space for sports, a trampoline, and even potential for a 20x30 pool, creating a personal oasis to relax and unwind. Just moments from the heart of Westport's vibrant culture and recreational activities, while offering a peaceful escape at the end of the day.
